title: Google Merchant Center (GMC) Feeds, Policies & Diagnostics
overview: Google Merchant Center synchronizes product catalog feeds to power Google Shopping ads, Performance Max campaigns, and Free Product Listings on Google Search.
coreConcepts: Primary vs. Supplemental feeds for attribute enrichment
Mandatory unique product identifiers: GTIN (UPC/EAN), MPN, and brand
Item status lifecycle: Active, Expiring, Disapproved, Pending Review
Automatic item updates for price and availability synchronization
features: Content API for Shopping for programmatic real-time SKU updates
Feed rules for transforming titles, descriptions, and custom labels (0-4)
Free product listings across Google Images, Search, and Shopping tabs
Promotion feeds for merchant-funded sales, promo codes, and discounts
bestPractices: Front-load high-volume keywords into product titles (Brand + Product + Color + Size)
Use Custom Labels (0-4) to segment products by margin, seasonality, or historical ROAS
Submit high-resolution product imagery (minimum 800x800 px) on pure white backgrounds
Set up automated daily feed fetches or Content API webhooks to prevent price mismatches
policies: Strict price and availability parity between product feed and website landing page
Prohibition of promotional text or watermarks inside primary product images
Mandatory contact information, return policy, and terms of service on site
limitations: Unedited product data expires automatically after 30 days without feed refresh
Feed upload size limit: 4 GB for direct file uploads
Account suspension risk if disapproved product percentage exceeds critical threshold
commonIssues: Disapproval for 'Mismatched value (page crawl): [price]' due to currency or sales tax display
Missing GTIN or invalid barcode numbers for manufactured goods
Image overlay policy rejections due to promotional badges or logos

troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Enable Automatic Item Updates in GMC settings and ensure structured microdata (schema.org/Product) matches feed price

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Missing GTIN error for custom or handmade products
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Set attribute 'identifier_exists' to 'no' in feed rules for eligible handmade SKUs
